uttari vāyāmamānassa sabbappayogesu dukkaṭaṁ, paṭilābhena nissaggiyaṁ hoti.
uggahaṇādīsu yaṁ kiñci karontassa aghanabaddhesu vatthūsu vatthugaṇanāya nissaggiyaṁ pācittiyaṁ.

nissaggiyaṁ.l: nissaggiyena nissaggiyaṁ āmasati, sevanādhippāyo kāyena vāyamati, na ca phassaṁ paṭivijānāti, āpatti dukkaṭassā

nissaggiyaṁ.g: taṁ yathāvuttajātippamāṇaṁ cīvaraṁ dasāhaparamaṁ kālaṁ atikkāmayato, etthantare yathā atirekacīvaraṁ na hoti, tathā akubbato nissaggiyaṁ pācittiyaṁ, tañca cīvaraṁ nissaggiyaṁ hoti, pācittiyāpatti cassa hotīti attho.
ettha evaṁ āṇattā bhikkhunī dhovanatthāya uddhanaṁ sajjeti, dārūni saṁharati, aggiṁ karoti, udakaṁ āharati, yāva naṁ dhovitvā ukkhipati, tāva bhikkhuniyā payoge payoge bhikkhussa dukkaṭaṁ.
sacepi sāsapamattaṁ hoti, sakiṁ vā aṅguliyā gahetvā jivhāya sāyanamattaṁ nissajjitabbameva, pācittiyañca desetabbaṁ.
ekaṁ cīvaraṁ ekābaddhāni ca bahūni acchindato ekā āpatti.

ettha āpattivuṭṭhāne “dasāhappaṭicchannaṁ pakkha-atirekapakkhamāsa- atirekamāsapaṭicchannan”ti-ādivacanabhedo viya, na idha vacanabhedo, tasmā saṁvaccharātikkantampi dasāhātikkantameva nāma, tathā dutiyakathinepi saṁvaccharavippavutthampi rattivippavutthameva.
mahantenapi paccāsācīvarena saha ghaṭitampi tabbhāvaṁ anupatitvā nissaggiyaṁ hoti sati pacchimappamāṇasambhave, asati na hoti, puna ghaṭite hoti, aññena ghaṭite na hoti.
“chārattaparamaṁ tena bhikkhunā tena cīvarena vippavasitabbaṁ, tato ce uttari vippavaseyyā”ti evaṁ vuttaṁ nissaggiyaṁ hoti.
vacanaṁ tulādhāraṇāya kiñcāpi na sameti, acittakattā pana sikkhāpadassa pubbe tulāya dhārayitvā ṭhapitesu ekampi lomaṁ tattha pateyya, nissaggiyanti ayamadhippāyoti no takko”ti2 ācariyo.
“yo pana bhikkhu aññātakaṁ gahapatiṁ vā gahapatāniṁ vā cīvaraṁ viññāpeyya aññatra samāyā, nissaggiyaṁ pācittiyan”ti3 iminā sikkhāpadena nissaggiyaṁ pācittiyaṁ.
